title: Choose the V2 workspace layout
question: Which structure best supports the customer, provider, and admin workspaces?

options.label: Role workspace
options.lineage: Purpose-built workspaces for distinct marketplace roles
options.thesis: Each role opens directly into the tools and data they need.
options.viewport: A persistent role-aware sidebar anchors a concise dashboard with task-specific data.
options.risk: Role-specific navigation needs clear shared account and logout controls.

options.label: Catalog-led marketplace
options.lineage: A searchable product catalog connected to role-specific tools
options.thesis: Product discovery leads; cart and inventory stay visible while browsing.
options.viewport: Search and price filters lead a product grid; a compact cart summary stays in view.
options.risk: The catalog is central to customers but secondary to provider and admin tasks.

options.label: Sales-led overview
options.lineage: Marketplace performance grouped by product and provider
options.thesis: Sales, stock, and unread purchases share one clear operational overview.
options.viewport: Admin and provider dashboards lead with totals, a product/provider chart, and a sortable sales table.
options.risk: Analytics-first views can make common catalog and editing tasks feel secondary.
